assumptions.groq_extra: 551: the largest difference between Groq's requested tokens and its input count in its refusal messages; an observed value, not a proven maximum
assumptions.relevance_output: 1772 per request: the largest recorded relevance answer times 1.25 (the relevance requests have no output limit)
assumptions.relevance_tries: 2 per request (one try and one retry)
assumptions.relevance_split: a batch over the minute limit splits in two, as the frozen relevance check does; the split is planned with the conservative token bound
assumptions.summary: 2 full attempts and 4 repairs (the most repair requests recorded for one summary at k = 5), each at the summary's input estimate plus the full output limit of 4,096
assumptions.no_groq_24h: the whole daily limit is used only after 24 hours with no Groq use; the user confirms this when starting the run; the code cannot see the Groq usage
assumptions.estimate: a conservative estimate from recorded requests, not a guaranteed maximum

report.decision: go only if no Groq use in the 24 hours before the run is confirmed; otherwise stop
